title: Strange  "Towels"
text: Strange  "Towels". These are different towels than I am used to. One side is terry cloth and the other side is smooth.  Not very plush by any means. Because the picture was poor and there was no description, I will tell you that these have a pale pink stripe on them. Had I known that I wouldn't have gotten them. These "towels" are more like a baby blanket than a bath towel and I think they should be described in that manner.  I really can't recommend these as towels, but if you need a baby shower item, these would work.
